name: mascot-reaction
description: Chillar pops up from the bottom of the content zone with an expression + animation and an optional deadpan speech bubble (a paper bubble, no outline). Replaces memes; counts as a re-hook. Can be an overlay on another scene. ring: optional short text on a green profile-photo ring around the coin (e.g. 'open to work'), drawn after the pop. sound: optional meme sound (e.g. 'vine boom'), fetched by pipeline/memes.py (soundPick picks the result), played soundAt s after the pop; it replaces the arrival coin and counts as a meme beat in the reel's meme budget. Default '' keeps the coin.
